notes.title: Last chance to grab Azurebreak Heroes -30% off! Also some future updates info.
notes.content:
Hello!
This is a reminder that the -30% launch sale ends in less than 7 hours.
Find out why it has 100% positive reviews!

Also, a roadmap for the near future:
-[b]December[/b]: small Quality of Life patch, better statistics info, trading materials, hard mode and some more...
-[b]Q1 2021[/b]: content update - a new character, a new map, some new artifacts

If you have any comments or requests for the December patch please leave them in the Community Hub.


[i]onyon[/i]

notes.title: Azurebreak Heroes is now available!
notes.content:
Hey!
After 2 years in development, Azurebreak Heroes is finally available to purchase & play on Steam and Nintendo Switch!

Hope you enjoy slaying demons in Heldia.

[i]onyon[/i]

notes.title: Azurebreak Heroes is Releasing 19.11.2020!
notes.content:
Hello, 
I'd like to announce that after 2 years in development, Azurebreak Heroes is finally coming out on [b]19th November 2020[/b]. There will also be a launch discount of [b]-30%[/b].

See you in Heldia!

[i]onyon[/i]
